notes.player:
Believed to contain a shard of the Emperor’s armour, this shield is wrought from layers of armaplas and ceramite, forming a protective barrier equal to @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.vhpvfuTVOEHEoM3S]{Power Armour}. Whatever additional anointments have blessed these shields over time, they carry an inherent righteousness and purity. Exclusively issued to members of the Adepta Sororitas, these icons of faith and devotion nonetheless have been known to be gifted to Inquisitors who distinguish themselves alongside the Sisters of Battle.

The Praesidium Protectiva is a Shield that can only be carried by a character in Power Armour. Further, a daemon, or a creature with a Warp Threshold, has a −20 penalty to all Tests against the bearer of a Praesidium Protectiva. (addditional rules and benefits for wielding @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.Wqnie6SvhIq6hZrS#shields]{Shields} are in Imperium Maledictum).

Carefully prepared layers of plasteel and ceramite, similar to Carapace Armour, form the bulk of a suit of Warded Armour. However, this armour’s true strength lies within the wards and sigils engraved into each heavy plate. Blessed by faithful artisans, each sigil of protection, each hexagrammic ward against the Immaterium, protects the wearer from daemonic entities and psychic powers.

Attempts to manifest a Psychic Power, targeting the wearer of Warded Armour or their Zone suffers from Disadvantage. daemon creatures have a −10 on all Tests against the wearer of Warded Armour.

Sanctified silver and iron, known as Truesilver, can be crafted into many forms as a potent weapon against immaterial powers and daemonic entities. Bands woven into the fabric of storm coats, and filigreed into plasteel plates, form cohesive protection against daemons and rogue psykers. They shine with a pure, silver-white light against the foul touch of the Immaterium.

A daemon, or a creature with a Warp Threshold, has a −10 penalty to all Tests against characters wearing Truesilver Weave.

A tower shield crafted from layers of plasteel and ceramite. The Crusader variant storm shield is a suppression shield re-designed to combat the enemies of the Ordo Malleus. The shield is sanctified with holy oils, its surface engraved with various hexagrammic wards and sigils against the Immaterium, making it a reliable defence against daemons.

A daemon, or a creature with a Warp Threshold, has a −10 penalty to all Tests against the bearer of a Crusader Storm Shield (addditional rules and benefits for wielding @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.Wqnie6SvhIq6hZrS#shields]{Shields} are in Imperium Maledictum).
